description.value: Nesters Market is a full-service neighbourhood supermarket in Osoyoos, part of a BC-born chain founded in Whistler in 1987 and now operated by the Pattison Food Group. The store emphasizes fresh, local, natural, and organic products alongside a deli and bistro, in-store bakery, and pharmacy. For touring cyclists in the South Okanagan, it offers one of the most comprehensive resupply stops in the region.
